item.title: azure: [Launched] Generally Available: Transparent data encryption (TDE) in Azure SQL Database AES keys
item.description:
Azure SQL Database now supports AES-256 keys in Azure Key Vault Premium or Managed HSM as Transparent Data Encryption (TDE) protectors. This provides an alternative to RSA keys for protecting data at rest.

  • Source: Azure Updates
